parameters.name: parent_overlay

confidenceValue.description: Confidence value for this point match (probability of match correctness). Value between 0.0 (high risk of matching to a wrong link) and 1.0 (very likely the matched link is the correct one). Currently the confidence value is simply derived from the distance between the original and the matched coordinate, but this will be refined in future releases.

elevation.description: Original GPS trace point elevation in meter height above the WGS84 reference ellipsoid. This value is taken from the request, and provided in the response for convenience.

headingDegreeNorthClockwise.description: Original GPS trace point heading (aka bearing or direction), in degree against North, clockwise. This value is taken from the request, and provided in the response for convenience. 10000 if not provided in the trace.

headingMatched.description: Heading of the road section at the matched position. Degree against North, clockwise.

matchDistance.description: Distance between the original trace point and the matched coordinate, in meter.

minError.description: Meter distance to the nearest road. This is a lower bound for the combined inaccuracy of GPS signal and map. 1000000.0 if it was not computed for this point.

routeLinkSeqNrMatched.description: Sequence number of the matched link within the route path. Starting at zero.

speedMps.description: Original GPS trace point speed value, in meter per second (independent of the originally provided unit). This value is taken from the request, and provided in the response for convenience.

applicableSpeedLimitKph.description: Only for drivingReport=1, speed limit for this vehicle at this date/time, including country wide general limits [kph]

timestamp.description: Milli seconds since 1/1/1970 UTC, unmodified from original trace, zero if trace contained no timestamps.

distToPrev.description: Spatial distance to previous original trace point, in meter.

distToPrevMatched.description: Spatial distance to previous matched coordinate, in meter.

breakDetected.description: Only available with restTimes parameter. Indicates a break is detected at this waypoint

breakDuration.description: Only available with restTimes parameter. Duration of a break in milliseconds detected at this waypoint

lateralAccelerationMpss.description: Only for drivingReport=1, lateral acceleration by centrifugal force [mpss]

accelerationMPSS.description: Only for drivingReport=1, longitudinal vehicle acceleration [mpss], breaking if negative

solarAltitudeAngle.description: Only for drivingReport=1, vertical sun position angle versus the flat earth surface [degree], 90 to -90, 0 = straight into driver's eyes

solarRelAltitudeAngle.description: Only for drivingReport=1, vertical sun position angle versus the current road surface considering the road slope and heading [degree], 90 to -90

solarRelHorizontalAngle.description: Only for drivingReport=1, horizontal sun position angle versus the driving direction [degree], 0 = straight into driver's eyes, 180 = in the back mirror

waypointType.description: Indicates waypoint type: `plannedWaypoint` - planned intermediate waypoint; `learnedStop` - waypoint derived from the driver's rest patterns learned by the API; `lastTracepoint` - the last position of the vehicle known by the API, often its current location.

type.description: Indicates waypoint type: `passThrough` for a waypoint that doesn't stop the journey, `stopOver` for a waypoint at which the journey stops for some time before it continues.

sideOfStreet.description:
Indicates whether the waypoint is located on the left or right side of the link in the direction of travel. Possible values are "left", "right", or "neither".
The "neither" value indicates that the waypoint is within three meters of the link or segment, which represents the centerline of a road section on the map. Three meters is approximately the width of a typical lane. This parameter is only available if the routeMatch=0 parameter was set.

mappedRoadName.description: Base name of the road. Empty means unknown or valid unnamed. Only available if parameter routeMatch=0 was set.

shapeIndex.description: index of the first shape coordinate in the shape array

action.description: Indicates whether actions should be included in the maneuvers. Supported actions are: depart, arrive, slightLeftTurn, leftTurn, sharpLeftTurn, leftUTurn , continue, slightRightTurn, rightTurn, sharpRightTurn, rightUTurn, RoundaboutExit, exit, uTurn, turn, keep.

firstPoint.description: Index into the global geometry array, pointing to the first point of the shape subsegment associated with this Maneuver. Must be followed by LastPoint.

travelTime.description: Time [sec] to drive until to this maneuver point

instruction.description: tagged driver instruction text in the requested language
instruction.example: Head West on M1 / Pacific Mtwy. Go for 56 m.

instructionAfter.example: After 56 m, take the exit onto 24

length.description: Distance [meter] to drive until to this maneuver point

direction.description: Indicates whether directions should be included in the maneuvers. Supported directions are: forward, lightRight, right, hardRight, uTurnRight, lightLeft, left, hardLeft, uTurnLeft.

lanes.description: List of lane infos, viewed into driving direction, from left to right. Applicable lanes marked '*', n = not allowed for vehicle or direction, numbers denote arrows, see Map Attributes layer LANE_FCn attribute DIRECTION_CATEGORY.

spot.description: 0...1 relative matched offset on link from reference node

layers.description: Names of map layers generated from the overlay submission

items.description: Names of map layers generated from the overlay submission

layerId.description: Layer name of geometries in a search response.

lastUpdateTimeStamp.description: last modification milli second timestamp for this layer. Only valid for custom layers, -1 for HERE map layer

X-Correlation-Id.description: Auto-generated id that uniquely identifies the request.

X-Request-Id.description: User-provided token that can be used to trace a request or a group of requests sent to the service.

apiKey.description: A key generated specifically to authenticate API requests. For more information on how to get an API key, see [Identity and Access Management Developer Guide](https://www.here.com/docs/bundle/identity-and-access-management-developer-guide).
apiKey.name: apiKey

bearerTokenAuth.description: A token obtained from a separate endpoint using client credentials and an OAuth 1.0a HMAC-SHA256 signed request. For more information on how to get a bearer token, see the [Identity and Access Management Developer Guide](https://www.here.com/docs/bundle/identity-and-access-management-developer-guide).
